en: The image is an illustrated postcard featuring an old European town square. The square is surrounded by multi-story historic buildings with arched porticoes and red-tiled roofs. Visible landmarks include a tall bell tower, a church with a dome, and a broad, elegant avenue with pedestrians. In the background, there are lush green mountains. The top of the postcard displays the text: 'Piazza Vittorio Emanuele III e Via Rodolfo Belenzani.'
